application_badges.title: Customer & Load Profiling
application_badges.description: Segments grid substations and hourly load regimes into operational archetype profiles without ground-truth labels.

application_badges.title: Anomaly & Outage Detection
application_badges.description: Isolates unclustered density noise samples indicating polar vortex freezes and unexpected substation tripping.

application_badges.title: Document & Pattern Grouping
application_badges.description: Groups multi-lag continuous load trajectories into distinct seasonal dispatch baselines.

application_badges.title: Bio-informatic & Temporal Discovery
application_badges.description: Clusters recurring cyclical demand sequences analogous to genomic sequence alignment.

linkages.name: Ward's Linkage (Default)
linkages.behavior: Minimizes within-cluster energy variance increase upon merge.
linkages.grid_impact: Generates tight, compact seasonal profiles; ideal for quantitative power demand curves.

linkages.name: Complete Linkage
linkages.behavior: Calculates the maximum pairwise distance between observations in clusters.
linkages.grid_impact: Enforces equal-diameter clusters; prevents blending peak hours into baseline regimes.

linkages.name: Average Linkage (UPGMA)
linkages.behavior: Averages pairwise distances across all observations between candidate clusters.
linkages.grid_impact: Robust against single outlier surges, balancing cluster size and compactness.

linkages.name: Single Linkage
linkages.behavior: Calculates the minimum pairwise distance between nearest observations.
linkages.grid_impact: Prone to the chaining effect; connects distinct weather profiles through transitory shoulder hours.
